from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import json,hashlib,re,requests,time
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
root=Path.cwd();out=root/"reports/research/510300_equal_production_all_original_month_cause_sources_v1"
(out/"raw").mkdir(exist_ok=False)
def now():return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
selected=[
 {"stat_month":"2022-07","url":"https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202302/t20230202_1896657.html","actual_search_title":"国家统计局服务业调查中心高级统计师赵庆河解读2022年7月中国采购经理指数"},
 {"stat_month":"2022-08","url":"https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202302/t20230202_1896667.html","actual_search_title":"国家统计局服务业调查中心高级统计师赵庆河解读2022年8月中国采购经理指数"},
 {"stat_month":"2023-01","url":"https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202302/t20230202_1896749.html","actual_search_title":"国家统计局服务业调查中心高级统计师赵庆河解读2023年1月中国采购经理指数"},
 {"stat_month":"2025-01","url":"https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202501/t20250127_1958499.html","actual_search_title":"国家统计局服务业调查中心高级统计师赵庆河解读2025年1月中国采购经理指数"}]
protocol=json.loads((out/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert [x["stat_month"] for x in selected]==protocol["new_fixed_target_months"]
(out/"实际四官方目标_GET前登记.json").write_text(json.dumps({"registered_at":now(),"selected_from_actual_fixed_search":True,"targets":selected,"max_GETs":4,"retries":0,"redirects":False,"authenticated":False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
def norm(s):return re.sub(r"\s+","",s).replace("\u3000","")
def get_one(z):
 rec={**z,"request_started_at":now(),"method":"GET","authenticated":False,"attempt":1,"retry_count":0,"redirects":False}
 session=requests.Session();session.trust_env=False
 try:
  resp=session.get(z["url"],timeout=(8,20),allow_redirects=False,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
  raw=resp.content;p=out/"raw"/("month_"+z["stat_month"]+".html");p.write_bytes(raw)
  soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,"html.parser")
  metadata=[{"name":m.get("name"),"content":m.get("content")} for m in soup.find_all("meta") if m.get("name") in ["ArticleTitle","PubDate","ContentSource"]]
  title_candidates=[m["content"] for m in metadata if m["name"]=="ArticleTitle"]+[soup.title.get_text(" ",strip=True) if soup.title else ""]
  ym=z["stat_month"];identity=str(int(ym[:4]))+"年"+str(int(ym[5:]))+"月"
  correct_title=any(identity in norm(t or "") and "解读" in norm(t or "") and "采购经理指数" in norm(t or "") for t in title_candidates)
  containers=soup.select(".TRS_Editor,.trs_editor,#zoom,#content")
  container=max(containers,key=lambda s:len(s.get_text(" ",strip=True))) if containers else None
  paras=[];aggregated=0
  if container:
   for node in container.find_all("p"):
    text=node.get_text(" ",strip=True)
    if node.find("p") is not None:aggregated+=1;continue
    if text and text not in paras:paras.append(text)
   body=container.get_text(" ",strip=True)
  else:body=""
  if not paras and body:paras=[body]
  whole=soup.get_text(" ",strip=True)
  minute_candidates=sorted(set(re.findall(r"20\d{2}[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}",whole)))
  rec.update({"received_at":now(),"http_status":resp.status_code,"resolved_url":resp.url,"response_bytes":len(raw),"raw_path":str(p.relative_to(root)).replace("\\","/"),"raw_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"content_type":resp.headers.get("Content-Type"),"location":resp.headers.get("Location"),
              "article_title_candidates":title_candidates,"title_month_identity_pass":correct_title,"html_metadata":metadata,"visible_minute_candidates":minute_candidates,"all_original_leaf_paragraphs":paras,"whole_original_body":body,"aggregated_parent_paragraphs_excluded":aggregated,
              "status":"RAW_ORIGINAL_IDENTITY_BODY_PASS" if resp.status_code==200 and correct_title and body else "SOURCE_OBJECT_NOT_ADMITTED_KEEP_UNKNOWN","historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False})
 except Exception as exc:rec.update({"received_at":now(),"status":"ONE_ATTEMPT_SOURCE_FAILURE_UNKNOWN","exception_type":type(exc).__name__,"error":str(exc)})
 finally:session.close()
 (out/("原GET_"+z["stat_month"]+"_实际收件.json")).write_text(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
 return rec
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:receipts=list(pool.map(get_one,selected))
(out/"原四官方收件_原段与时钟.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipts,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"original_GETs":4,"retries":0,"receipts":[{k:x.get(k) for k in ["stat_month","http_status","response_bytes","status","title_month_identity_pass","html_metadata","visible_minute_candidates"]} for x in receipts]},ensure_ascii=False))
